answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13412 Country: India Title: If prayer time has started and I pray sunnah before adhan is it necessary to repet sunn rakt again for exampl if in dohr salah I prayed 4 rakah sunnah and after completion or while praying adhan started is it obligatery to repeat 4 rakah sunnah? Question: If prayer time has started and I pray sunnah before adhan is it necessary to repet sunn rakt again for exampl if in dohr salah I prayed 4 rakah sunnah and after completion or while praying adhan started is it obligatery to repeat 4 rakah sunnah? Answer ID: 13412 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 901/901=M/1430) The sunnah was valid, there is no need to repeat it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
